results.question: What are the most capable LLMs available today?
results.answer: Based on retrieved web sources, the most capable LLMs available include GPT-4 by OpenAI (with text and image inputs), Claude by Anthropic (using constitutional AI for safety), Gemini by Google DeepMind (multimodal), and Llama 2 by Meta (open-source, up to 70B parameters).

results.question: How many parameters does Llama 2 have and who created it?
results.answer: Llama 2 was created by Meta and comes in sizes ranging from 7 billion to 70 billion parameters. The fine-tuned Llama 2-Chat variants are optimised for dialogue and were trained on 2 trillion tokens of publicly available data.

results.question: How was GPT-4 evaluated on professional exams?
results.answer: GPT-4 was evaluated on the Uniform Bar Exam, scoring in the top 10% — a dramatic improvement over GPT-3.5, which scored around the bottom 10%. GPT-4 accepts both text and image inputs and uses RLHF for alignment.
